telemetry_provenance_summary.limitation_disclosure: Customer VPC OpenTelemetry collector not active; live customer cluster telemetry is NOT VERIFIED. All 10 cases are sanitized historical incident postmortem replay fixtures evaluated in supervised shadow mode.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-084 (HikariCP connection pool acquisition timeout under thread starvation)
cases.vermithor_top_1_diagnosis: Database connection pool exhaustion on payment-core
vermithor_top_3_diagnoses: Database connection pool exhaustion on payment-core
cases.operator_notes: Vermithor correctly isolated the pool exhaustion within 14s, confirming the SRE team's remediation plan to scale max_pool_size.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-091 (Okta IdP signing certificate expiration causing universal JWT verification failure)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: IdP certificate expiry causing 401 Unauthorized token validation cascades
cases.operator_notes: Immediate top-1 identification prevented on-call engineers from chasing phantom database errors.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-103 (Redis maxmemory reached under unevicted session tokens causing eviction storm)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: Redis maxmemory OOM command rejection during flash sale traffic
cases.operator_evidence_citation: LOG-OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory', METRIC-redis_evicted_keys_rate
cases.operator_notes: Accurate hypothesis allowed operators to immediately execute the Redis memory expansion SOP.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-112 (CoreDNS UDP timeout causing checkout to timeout on downstream partner pay API)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: Upstream CoreDNS UDP packet timeout causing client connection stalls
cases.operator_notes: Vermithor correctly identified that checkout was timing out on downstream calls, but attributed it to partner latency rather than local CoreDNS drops. Still helped operators narrow the investigation to external network egress.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-119 (Ext4 filesystem inode exhaustion from uncleaned headless chrome temp files)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: No space left on device: Ext4 inode depletion on /tmp
cases.operator_evidence_citation: LOG-IOException: No space left on device, METRIC-disk_inode_usage_ratio=1.0
cases.operator_notes: Saves SREs from debugging memory or CPU by pointing directly to filesystem saturation.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-125 (Native C-extension memory leak in crypto signature verification causing cgroup OOM killer invocation)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: Container killed by Linux OOM killer (ExitCode 137, SIGKILL)
cases.operator_notes: Clear memory exhaustion finding grounded in cgroup RSS metrics.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-130 (False alarm from scheduled database backup maintenance window with stale telemetry)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: Planned backup window telemetry outside operational incident threshold; correctly abstained
cases.operator_evidence_citation: ANOMALY-EVALUATION: No metrics exceeding critical threshold
cases.operator_notes: Abstention prevented unnecessary paging of secondary on-call engineer.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-141 (Malformed JSON payload poison pill causing Kafka consumer partition 3 stall)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: Kafka consumer group stall caused by poison pill message in partition 3
cases.operator_notes: Vermithor abstained because the metric kafka_consumer_lag_records did not match keyword 'queue'. Safe abstention, but missed the root cause.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-149 (PostgreSQL row-level deadlocks during concurrent renewal billing cycles)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: PostgreSQL transaction deadlock detected on subscription table
cases.operator_evidence_citation: LOG-DeadlockDetected: process 48192 waits for ShareLock, METRIC-postgres_deadlocks_count
cases.operator_notes: Identified database lock contention accurately, confirming index and locking query remediation.

cases.independent_postmortem_source: Postmortem PM-2026-155 (Transient public cloud transit jitter resolving automatically without service disruption)
cases.operator_confirmed_root_cause: Transient network packet jitter within SLA bounds; correctly abstained from false diagnosis
cases.operator_notes: Proper abstention prevented spurious code repair proposals or unnecessary incident escalation.
